scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w rewear-api" "npm run dev -w rewear-web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w rewear-web && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('dist', 'frontend/dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build -w rewear-web && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('dist', 'frontend/dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run seed -w rewear-api
